budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Sewer Commission updated the Article 14 amount for a decrease in capital costs, covering a Fitchburg sewer rate increase and an unbudgeted retiree cost; $8,000 was removed from the warrant article and retained earnings are now stated.
budget_items.quote: the sewer commission has met and updated the amount to account for the decrease in capital costs by $15,231.55, which covers an increase in fitchburg sewer rates ($6,600), and an unbudgeted retiree cost of $8,631.53.

budget_items.topic: Proposed Capital Plan funding, with and without ARPA
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Without ARPA funds the proposed Capital Plan would fund $1,039,010, a 52% decrease from FY23; with ARPA funds it funds $2,025,010, a 6.4% decrease from FY23. Free cash for FY24 is lower because the overlay account must be filled.
budget_items.quote: without the use of arpa funds, the proposed capital plan would fund $1,039,010, a 52% decrease from fy23.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town would under-levy about $1,500,000 if all abatements were granted; the Town Manager recommended transferring $1,500,000 from Free Cash to the Overlay Account.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has recommended the transfer of $1,500,000 from free cash to the overlay account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The report prints a table of levy limit, new growth, debt exclusion and total taxes; total taxes are shown as $29,959,875.61 (FY22 Final), $30,875,655.64 (FY23 Final) and $31,477,704.00 (FY24 Budgeted), with year-over-year changes of 3.06% and 1.95%.

budget_items.topic: Debt service and excludible debt reduction
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Debt Service and Excludible Debt is to fall 14.6% from FY23 to FY24 as Public Safety Building and Primary School debt retires and an MSBA reimbursement completes, freeing debt capacity.
budget_items.quote: the end of fy23 will see a 14.6% reduction of our debt service and excludible debt, from $3,174,257.53 (fy23)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An analysis by Unibank projected debt capacity scenarios; the Town has $42,000,000 usable while staying under debt capacity limits.
budget_items.quote: in total, the town has $42,000,000 that will be useable while remaining under debt capacity limits.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Federal relief provided $3,500,000 in ARPA funds and $1,900,000 in ESSER funds; ESSER allowed the School Department to hire 13 new positions and the last ESSER funds must be spent by end of September 2024.
budget_items.quote: federal relief, during the covid-19 pandemic, provided lunenburg with $3,500,000 in arpa funds and $1,900,000 in esser funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Select Board voted to spend $986,000 of ARPA funds on three Capital Plan items (a Rescue Ambulance at $506,000 and two dump trucks at $240,000 each); $2,514,000 remains unallocated.
budget_items.quote: the select board voted to spend $986,000 in arpa funds to order three items from the capital plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chapter 70 rose 11.5% in FY23 against a 20.4% Monty Tech assessment increase; FY24 Chapter 70 is likely to rise 0.6% against a 12% Monty Tech increase, which will not offset it. The committee met the State Delegation about formulas for small municipalities.
budget_items.quote: while fy23 did see a larger than expected increase (11.5%) in chapter 70 (public school funding) funds, the outlook for fy24 is the likely mandatory minimum increase resulting in a 0.6% increase.

transfers.description: Recommended transfer of Free Cash to the Overlay Account to cover potential abatements.
transfers.outcome: recommended by the Town Manager; the minutes record no committee vote on it
transfers.quote: the town manager has recommended the transfer of $1,500,000 from free cash to the overlay account.
